question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Boldness
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bravery**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SYNONYM** is a phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Bravery **is a noun which means fearless behavior or character .

*Example *: Saving a dog from dog catchers was an act of **bravery**.

 
• The word **Boldness **means eagerness to take dangers and act imaginatively; confidence or strength.

*Example *: She crossed all the limits of **boldness **by wearing that dress.

 
• The meaning of word boldness is **similar **to the meaning of word bravery , **hence bravery is the answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Hard heartedness **means missing in sympathetic understanding

Example : You would have to be pretty hard-hearted not to feel something for him.

 
• The word** Eagerness** means excitement to do or to have something; perception.

Example : I appreciated her **eagerness **to learn more.

 
• The word **Wisdom **means the quality of having experience, information, and great judgment; the quality of being astute.

Example : **Wisdom **is the key to success.
